svg.title: Encoded size against UTF-8, by language (UDHR, 16-char values)
svg.desc: Bar chart of the encoded size of UDHR, 16-char values in Steno, SCSU, BOCU-1 and UTF-16 as a percentage of UTF-8, per language. The same numbers are in the table UDHR, 16-Char Values, under Size by Language.
svg.text: Encoded size against UTF-8, by language (UDHR, 16-char values)
Size as a percentage of the UTF-8 size; smaller is better. 100% is UTF-8.
SCSU sizes are those of ICU's encoder.
